label: Бояться
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for бояться (to be afraid).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present, reflexive. 'Боюсь' is the 1sg of reflexive бояться, ending in -ю plus the particle -сь. 'Высоты' is the genitive object of fear.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Боишься' shows the -ишь ending plus -ся of бояться. 'Темноты' is again the genitive of what is feared.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Боится' is the -ит form of бояться with -ся. 'Больших собак' is the genitive plural object of fear.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Боимся' carries the -им ending plus -ся of бояться. Here the fear takes an infinitive, 'опоздать', rather than a noun.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Боитесь' trains the -ите form plus -сь of бояться. 'Этого человека' is the genitive object of fear.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Боятся' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending plus -ся of бояться. 'Грозы' is the genitive of the feared storm.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Боялся' is the masculine singular past of бояться, with -л before the reflexive -ся. 'В детстве' anchors the time.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Боялась' adds the feminine -ла plus -сь of бояться. The fear governs the infinitive 'говорить'.
Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Боялись' is the plural -ли past plus -сь of бояться. 'Перемен' is the genitive plural object of their fear.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Бойся' is the informal command of бояться, with the reflexive -ся kept; the negation 'не' turns it into a common reassurance, 'don't be afraid'.
